configSchema.description: `pass` iff `confidence ≥ threshold` and (`requireValue` is false or the decision is boolean with `value === true`); otherwise `fail` iff `reviewBand` is set and `confidence < threshold − reviewBand`; otherwise `review`. Without `reviewBand` the gate is two-way (`pass`/`review`, as in §2.9); with it the band `[threshold − reviewBand, threshold)` goes to review and everything below to `fail`; a `requireValue` failure routes `fail` when `reviewBand` is set, else `review`. The UI's two-threshold model maps onto this as `auto := threshold`, `review := threshold − (reviewBand ?? threshold)`, with outcome names `pass | review | fail`.

x-ui.help: Also require a boolean decision value of true to pass.
Optional. Width of the review band below the threshold: confidences in [threshold − reviewBand, threshold) go to review, lower ones to fail. Unset, the gate is two-way (pass/review).

controlPorts.description: confidence ≥ threshold (and, with requireValue, a boolean value of true).

controlPorts.name: pass

controlPorts.description: Below threshold; with reviewBand only within [threshold − reviewBand, threshold).
controlPorts.label: Needs review
controlPorts.name: review

controlPorts.description: Only with reviewBand: confidence < threshold − reviewBand, or a requireValue failure.
controlPorts.label: Fail
controlPorts.name: fail

Passes the decision through and reports `passed` and `outcome`.
metadata.name: Confidence gate
